learning_outcomes.text: Engineers should have knowledge about the problems they will encounter in industrial enterprises where they will work or interact with workers, employers, the state, and non-governmental organizations, and their solutions.
Gaining the ability to easily communicate with patient and scientific approaches, quickly perceive problems, and resolve crises with negotiation techniques.

syllabus_topics: Emergence of Industrial Relations, Industrial Revolution and its Causes
Ottoman and Republic Period Developments, Factors of Production and Ideologies
Worker-Employer Relations System (Labor Markets, Labor, Employment, Unemployment, Wages, Labor Productivity)
Parties in the Worker-Employer Relations System (State, Employers, Unions, Types of Unions)
Collective Bargaining, Negotiations, Collective Agreements, Rights and Interest Disputes
Resolution Methods in Case of Dispute (Conciliation, Mediation, Arbitration, Strike and Lockout)
Industrial Democracy and Mergers (Elections, Representation Authority, Company Mergers)
New Industrial Relations (Human Resources Management and Corporate Culture)
New Industrial Relations (Employment Relationship and Use of Power)
New Industrial Relations (Complaint, Discipline and Suggestion Systems)
New Industrial Relations (Environment, Worker Health and Safety)
New Industrial Relations (Participation in Management and Subcontracting)
Non-Governmental Organizations, Globalization and Global Organizations
